title: Florida House, District 74
what_it_does: Represents District 74 (Part of Sarasota) in the Florida House; votes on state laws and the state budget.
verified_ballot_note: Candidate list taken from the Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list on 2026-09-18 (https://dos.elections.myflorida.com/candidates/CanList.asp); statuses Qualified/Unopposed only. Counties from the Legislature's district listings. Positions have not been researched yet.

candidates.name: Nick Pachota
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.occupation: Mayor of Venice; paramedic/firefighter; co-owner, Venice Pier Group restaurants
candidates.background: Mayor of Venice and a career EMT, paramedic, firefighter and SWAT medic who co-owns the Venice Pier Group, including Sharky's on the Pier, and teaches in Sarasota County Public Schools' EMS program. A Cardinal Mooney High School graduate, he is married with two grown daughters. Won the Aug. 18, 2026 Republican primary.
